timed_stop.timer_bypassed_counterexample: With KEN and KS held in position, OEM releases first; B welded and normal maintained A can restart upon STOP release.
timed_stop.out_of_envelope: For a pulse shorter than capture or too much auxiliary skew the bypass counterexample can recur. No timing values were measured on the installation.

reset: pre-held RESET, early press during idle qualification, break-before-make travel and proper re-arm passed

fault_limits.enable_seal: additional KEN bridge plus retained A and B can permit restart after the delay
fault_limits.enable_output: additional KEN bridge plus retained A and B can permit restart after the delay
fault_limits.trip_gate_short: additional short can allow pickup during remaining KS mechanical release time; no single-fault safety rating
fault_limits.pilot_gate_short: additional short can allow pickup during remaining KS mechanical release time; no single-fault safety rating
fault_limits.frozen or welded automatic outputs: no guaranteed automatic stop; factory STOP still trips
fault_limits.retained upstream A demand masked by KFB: fresh manual enable can restore A; B or factory pickup still needed

electrical_envelope.limits: Engineering corners, not measurements. Check current, leakage, pulse shapes and gate margins across installed temperature/load, including SSR thermal derating, exact specified DC-only -D-H switching performance, cabling and the actual flyback load.

limitations: Common rail fully drops for a sustained shared supply outage. Short dips and supply hold-up require measurement.
Downstream OEM pilot lead interruption and restoration with pickup held can restart without a STOP event.
AC voltage trip depends on working HOST firmware and a working command path. Hardware LOCAL retains OEM control.
